item.title: Clearer sponsorship limit changes
item.summary: When you raise a group’s monthly sponsorship limit, the review action is now easier to spot and the confirmation clearly shows the old and new maximum.
item.details: Murph makes no change until you choose the new limit. If Murph cannot confirm the result, the confirmation stays open so you can check the current limit or confirm cancellation status; canceling a sponsorship now uses the same in-page confirmation pattern.
